nature: Messages fictifs et étiquettes illustratives ; aucune inférence connectée.

messages.texte: I had an amazing day today!
I feel disappointed by what happened.
I cannot believe this finally happened!
Your help made my day so much better.
I miss the moments we shared.
I am afraid of making the wrong choice.
It feels wonderful to celebrate together.
